eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Coconino, AZ; at 1:34 PM on AUG 20, 2025 Effective until 9:34 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: CCSO:  Due to the Sheep Springs Fire, the Forest Lakes Area is placed into SET.  This includes the north and south sides of Highway 260 between mile post 286 and mile post 291. Canyon Point Campground is also included in this status.  Be aware of your surroundings, follow official news sources and be prepared to evacuate if ordered.
